prompt: Send personalized follow-up emails 7 days post-purchase to encourage reviews, while respecting customers who have already re-engaged.

intent.desiredOutcome: Send personalized follow-up emails 7 days post-purchase to encourage reviews, while respecting customers who have already re-engaged.

platformGaps.gap: No batch write API for sending emails — each customer requires an individual email send call
platformGaps.mitigation: Pre-fetch all eligible orders and customer data before the loop; per-item email sends inside the loop are unavoidable for this resource type

platformGaps.gap: Shopify does not expose a native 're-engagement' signal (e.g. repeat purchase within 7 days) as a webhook field
platformGaps.mitigation: Track re-engagement by querying Shopify Orders API for orders placed by the same customer after the original order date; if a newer paid order exists within the window, skip the email send

cronBatching.description: Before the loop, bulk-fetch all review_followup_queue rows where status='pending' and scheduled_send_date <= today. For each batch, resolve the corresponding Shopify order and customer details (name, email, order date, order name) via the Admin API in bulk where possible. Also query Shopify Orders API per customer to detect re-engagement (subsequent paid order) before deciding to send.

columns.name: queue_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES review_followup_queue(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

columns.name: email_subject
columns.constraints: NOT NULL DEFAULT 'How was your order? We''d love your review!'

columns.name: email_body_template
columns.constraints: NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hi {{first_name}}, thank you for your order {{order_name}}. We''d love to hear your feedback!'

webhookContract.handlerMustProduce: From the orders/paid webhook payload, extract order id (BIGINT), order name, customer object (id, email, first_name), and the order's processed_at timestamp. Compute scheduled_send_date as processed_at date + days_after_purchase days (read from review_followup_settings for the tenant, defaulting to 7). Insert a row into review_followup_queue with status='pending' only if no row already exists for this order_id and tenant_id. Use customer.email or the top-level email field as customer_email. customer_id may be null for guest orders.

cronContract.handlerMustProduce: Query all review_followup_queue rows where tenant_id matches, status='pending', and scheduled_send_date <= today's date. For each row, resolve full customer details (first_name, email) from the Shopify Admin API using customer_id if available, otherwise use stored customer_email. Check whether the customer has placed any additional paid orders after order_paid_at by querying Shopify Orders API filtered by customer_id and created_at > order_paid_at — if a newer paid order exists and skip_if_reengaged is true in settings, mark the queue row status='skipped' with skipped_reason='reengaged' and log the action. Otherwise, send a personalized review-request email using the email_subject and email_body_template from settings (interpolating first_name and order_name), then mark queue row status='sent', set sent_at=now(), and insert a row into review_followup_log with action='sent'.
